annotations.title: Preview what Bucky has on file for an address

description: Free preview, no sign-in needed. For one street address in Canada or the US, it says whether Bucky covers the place and which zoning facts it holds for the lot (lot boundary, zone, height, density, setbacks, permitted uses, overlays, parking): found, partly on file, or not on file. It returns no values: no zone code, heights, setbacks or areas. The lot outline is a shape with no scale. Use it when the user is not signed in and asks what they can build at an address. For the numbers, call checkSite. That call asks the user to sign in.

address.description: Street address to analyse, e.g. "4170 Sophia St, Vancouver BC".

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.
